{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 2 is the 58th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 2nd day of Aquarius, and it is a Tuesday. It corresponds to ISO week 9, weekday 2.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮2日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 58|Chapter 58]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152078}}.
